## Early Move-Out Checklist for a Manchester Tenancy

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg

- Review the lease clause on early exit, rent liability, and re-letting costs.
- Check the notice period and the exact date you want to leave: **2026-02-15**.
- Prepare a replacement-tenant plan: ask whether the landlord will accept a new tenant, what referencing standards apply, and who will market the property.
- Keep paying rent until the landlord confirms a replacement tenant or agrees in writing to end the tenancy earlier.
- Ask for all agreements in writing, including any fee estimate for reasonable re-letting costs.
- Document the property condition with photos before you leave and arrange a checkout inspection.
- Return keys only after the handover date is confirmed.

## Tenant Request Message to the Landlord

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/phone.svg

Subject: Request for early tenancy end and replacement tenant search

Dear [Landlord/Agent Name],

I hope you are well. I am writing regarding my 12-month tenancy that began on 1 September 2025. Due to a job relocation, I would like to request an early end to the tenancy from 15 February 2026 if possible.

I understand that under the lease I remain responsible for rent until a replacement tenant is found, and that reasonable re-letting costs may apply. I would be grateful if you could let me know the process for advertising the property and what steps I should take to help find a suitable replacement tenant as quickly as possible.

Please also confirm:
- the notice you need from me
- any referencing requirements for a replacement tenant
- any reasonable re-letting costs or admin fees
- the preferred date for checkout and key return

I appreciate your help and would be glad to cooperate fully to make the handover as smooth as possible.

Kind regards,
[Your Name]
[Property Address]
[Phone Number]

## Practical Next Steps

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg

- Send the message as soon as possible.
- Offer to cooperate with viewings and referencing.
- Keep a written record of all replies.
- Do not assume the tenancy ends automatically on 2026-02-15 unless the landlord confirms it in writing.

## Sources

- UK government tenancy guidance: https://www.gov.uk/private-renting-tenancy-agreements
- Citizens Advice on ending a tenancy: https://www.citizensadvice.org.uk/housing/renting-a-home/tenancy-agreements/
- Shelter on leaving a private tenancy: https://england.shelter.org.uk/housing_advice/private_renting/leaving_a_private_rented_home
